subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover narrative text from trajectory when session archived early (#87182)

question: Should `cleanup: "keep"` be the supported cross-plugin contract for retaining session-store state until a host calls `deleteSession`, or should this behavior be narrowed to an explicit lifecycle capability for callers that require post-run reads?
rationale: The branch changes cleanup semantics beyond memory-core, and the available evidence does not establish the deletion behavior of every keep-mode caller.

options.title: Confirm and prove the keep-mode contract
options.body: Treat explicit host deletion as the keep-mode contract, audit affected callers, and add exact-head lifecycle proof before merging.

options.title: Narrow the retention behavior
options.body: Use an explicit post-run-read capability or caller-specific path if broad keep-mode retention would leave sessions behind for existing plugin callers.

recommendation.title: Confirm and prove the keep-mode contract
recommendation.body: Treat explicit host deletion as the keep-mode contract, audit affected callers, and add exact-head lifecycle proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review established the accepted architectural direction and the remaining lifecycle-contract concern.
